subject: Intermittent 503s on /v1/generate — field repro and mitigation plan
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@novum.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Strange 503 errors hitting /v1/generate (prod)

Sergio —

We're seeing intermittent 503s hitting /v1/generate from our production service between 08:50 and 09:00 PST. The errors are non-deterministic but appear to spike when we send batches of ~40 concurrent requests at ~512-token context. I attached a trace and a small Postman collection that reproduces it from our side.

Sample error in logs: 
{"timestamp":"2026-02-20T08:57:23Z","trace_id":"tx-9b3a","status":503,"msg":"runtime: model instance oom or route-mismatch"} 

Can you escalate? Our trial is in the last week and this affects a demo next Tuesday.

— Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Sr. Platform Eng, Novum Health

Attachments: novum-error-trace.txt, repro-postman-collection.json

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@novum.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Strange 503 errors hitting /v1/generate (prod)

Forwarding Taylor's report — we need a quick triage. Key points:
- Customer reproduces with ~40 concurrent requests, 512 token contexts.
- Trace id tx-9b3a attached, plus Postman reproduction.
- Impact: blocking a demo next Tue; customer trial conversion at risk (RDW-8742).

Immediate asks:
1) Dev: can you reproduce locally with the collection? Any quick mitigation (routing to fallback variant / reduce concurrency)?
2) Marcus: could this be an autoscaling/routing anomaly or a kernel OOM that surfaces as a 503?
3) Maya: flag this as priority for PM/runtime sync and we may need a controlled rollback or routing override.

I can propose a mitigation to the customer (fallback to quantized variant or temporary concurrency cap) but want dev/runtime input first.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Strange 503 errors hitting /v1/generate (prod)

Thanks for the signal + repro. I pulled the trace (tx-9b3a) — looks like the LRU KV-cache eviction path triggered while the request was mid-generation; when eviction races with a request for a prefetched KV page we sometimes return a 503 with the "route-mismatch" symptom.

Repro steps ran locally against a dev replica using the provided Postman collection; I can reproduce on n1-standard with a stress script (40 concurrent, 512 tokens) when I enable aggressive cache trimming.

Immediate mitigations I can try over the next few hours:
- Disable aggressive eviction for Novum's route (safest, fast).
- Route traffic to a quantized variant (less memory pressure) as a temporary fallback.
- Add a retry with jitter client-side (not ideal for demos).

I'm opening JIRA RUNTIME-9123 and attaching the trace & repro. If Marcus can confirm whether an autoscaler or routing reassignment occurred at 08:57 that would help.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Runtime Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: repro-postman-collection.json

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Strange 503 errors hitting /v1/generate (prod)

Checked the cluster events for the time window — no autoscaler flaps, but one of the model variants on the node pool experienced a kernel allocation failure and the serving runtime marked that instance "degraded" and moved routing. That routing change plus simultaneous cache eviction could explain the transient 503s.

Short-term: I prepared a hotfix that makes the eviction path tolerant to in-flight lookups and avoids the early 503; attaching a small patch (hotfix-patch.diff). We can gate deploy to the dedicated pool serving Novum.

Operational mitigation: enable routing override to quantized-variant for the customer's route and disable aggressive eviction for their tenant for 48 hours.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Platform Lead, Inference Runtime
Attachments: hotfix-patch.diff

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@novum.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Strange 503 errors hitting /v1/generate (prod)

Taylor —

Quick update from engineering: we can mitigate this immediately in two ways:
1) Route your requests to a quantized model variant we host (no change to your calls) — eliminates the memory pressure that triggered the issue.
2) If you prefer to keep the same variant, we can temporarily disable aggressive cache eviction for your tenant (48h window) while we hotfix the eviction race.

We recommend #1 for fastest resolution; Marcus has a hotfix ready to deploy as well. Do you want us to flip the route now (will require a brief (~2m) routing update but no downtime)? Also copying Laura for quick credit / SLA exception if the demo impact requires it.

If we have permission I'll schedule the change for 10:00 PST today and monitor the route for 1 hour and send you the results.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
